user.title: Energy Node Companion
user.description:
Home Assistant supplies the energy-node dashboard with history from its recorder and shows the dashboard in its sidebar. Enter the dashboard address in the tailnet with port 8080, for example {example_url}.

Port 8080 is required. It is the dashboard's own port. Port 80 belongs to the reverse proxy, which breaks the sign-in for the sidebar.

reconfigure.title: Energy Node Companion
reconfigure.description: Change the dashboard address or port. Use port 8080, the dashboard's own port, not port 80.

error.invalid_url: The address must start with http:// or https://.
error.cannot_connect: The dashboard cannot be reached at this address.
error.wrong_protocol: The dashboard speaks a different version of the history exchange.
error.dashboard_too_old: The dashboard is too old. Update the energy-node first.

abort.already_configured: This dashboard is already set up.
abort.reconfigure_successful: The dashboard address has been changed.

init.title: Energy Node Companion
init.description: Choose what the integration does. History, energy statistics or the sidebar must stay on. Name and icon apply to the sidebar entry.

data_description.history: Fills gaps in the dashboard's history charts from the recorder.
data_description.stats: Sends hourly energy per role from the long-term statistics, so the dashboard can show days, months and years.
data_description.panel: Shows the dashboard in the Home Assistant sidebar, for all users or only for administrators.
data_description.pairing_code: Create the code in the dashboard under Settings, Users, Home Assistant. Home Assistant users can then sign in to the dashboard.

stats.title: Energy statistics
stats.description: Pick an energy meter per role if you have one. A meter is more exact and reaches further back. Empty uses the power sensor of Energy Node. Wallbox and heat pump work the same way once they are assigned in Energy Node.

error.nothing_enabled: Turn on history, energy statistics or the sidebar. With all of them off the integration does nothing.
error.not_a_counter: This sensor is not a meter. Pick an energy sensor with the state class total or total_increasing.
error.pairing_invalid: The pairing code is invalid or has expired.
error.pairing_failed: Pairing failed. Is port 8081 of the node reachable?
